study: H1 V2 bounded accuracy, matched exposure, and supervised head calibration
role: development_only; S0-S4; published S5-S12 never opened or used
architecture: single causal Conv1d/ReLU per dilation, kernel3 width32, linear7; no future input

training.dropout_scope: one source-mean replacement mask per chunk/channel, constant over time
training.common_training_positions: all arms exclude first62 bins/file; real preceding context is RF-1, right pad excluded
training.transforms: input mean/std all training neural rows; target mean/std training scored rows only
training.source_units_loss: standardized residual squared times target_scale squared / mean(target_scale squared)

schedule_check.rule: choose40 only if four-arm mean validation VW-R2 gain >=0.005 and no arm loses >0.01; otherwise20
schedule_check.scope: one global epoch count, written and hashed before any outer S2-S4 scoring

diagnostics.same_day: prefix of first file that day; evaluate complete last file that day
diagnostics.earlier_days: same raw bin budget from chronological tail of all earlier-day files, retaining file boundaries
diagnostics.label_match: exclude first62 bins of each selected segment, then retain earliest scored labels up to the smaller eligible count across conditions
diagnostics.learning_curves: 25/50/100 percent of first same-day file duration; all three seeds; one fixed selected epoch count
diagnostics.interpretation: matched neural-duration and label-count diagnostic; behavior distributions and number of resets may differ

calibration.prefix_labels: original eval_mask within first budget/0.02 bins only; no suffix labels
calibration.state: all neural bins ingested causally; reset at file only; prefix predictions remain unadapted until fitting boundary
calibration.latent_features: 32-D final ReLU activations standardized using source-training neural rows only
calibration.ridge_objective: mean residual SSE plus lambda times squared delta-head coefficients; unpenalized intercept; anchored to original prediction
calibration.arms: all four main arms, all seeds/folds; no calibration setting search

metrics.primary: equal-day mean variance-weighted R2, separately per seed and seed mean
metrics.all_results: retain every arm, seed, day, budget, negative score and failed attempt
metrics.selection: candidate eligible only if mean paired gain across all seeds/days >=0.005 and no seed-mean day gain <-0.01; choose eligible highest mean R2, then fewer parameters, then listed arm order; otherwise retain rf15_standardized; runtime candidate always selected arm seed0/S4; development-only selection

execution.fit_count: 4 nested schedule fits +36 main fits +54 matched-exposure diagnostic fits; calibration is closed-form
execution.publication: aggregate scores/counts/timing/provenance only; model weights, calibration coefficients and full predictions private
execution.performance_scope: training wall time and correctness only; no latency campaign while parallel work runs
execution.checkpoint_format: numeric NPZ, allow_pickle=False, version, architecture, affine transforms, exact state arrays
execution.streaming: test full-file, chunk and explicit causal-step parity; preserve feature-only interface
